title: The Last Deadline
author: Mirabel Galloway
blurb: Noor Coldharbour, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
